tagline: Offline Torah Notes & Handwriting OCR Studio
taglineYiddish: דער קלוגער כתב-קוקער פאר שיעורים און חידושי תורה
releaseTitle: v1.2.0 — In-App Update Checker (GitHub Cloud & Local Network Share) with Clean Upgrade Process
description: Ksav Kooker (כתב קוקער) v1.2.0 adds a full-featured 'Check for Updates' tool in the Help menu (Ctrl+U) with dual update channels (GitHub Cloud and Local Network Share/Server folder), alongside a clean upgrade installer engine that prevents file-locking conflicts and purges obsolete binaries while fully preserving all user handwriting data.
features: In-App Update Checker (Help > Check for Updates... or Ctrl+U): Easily check if a newer version is available without leaving the application.

Dual Update Channels (Configurable): Choose between Official GitHub Cloud (online) or a Local Network Share / UNC Domain Folder / USB Drive (e.g. \\newltcserver\Installs\KsavKooker or M:\...) for offline institutional environments.
One-Click Offline Upgrades: When pointed to a network folder containing KsavKooker_Setup.exe, updates can be launched directly with a single click.
Automatic Running Process Detection: The setup wizard detects if Ksav Kooker is running and gracefully closes it before file extraction, preventing Windows permission errors.
Clean Binary Purge on Upgrade: Upgrading cleans out old application binaries and obsolete cached modules in the installation directory to prevent file bloat and conflicts.
100% User Data Isolation: All personal handwriting profiles, learned mistake rules, backups, and settings in %APPDATA% remain completely untouched during upgrades.
High-Contrast Windows Setup Wizard: Crisp, readable slate typography and verified 3D logo emblem rendering.
Native Windows Menu Bar & Stacked Workflow: Standard File, Scan & OCR, Learning, View, Language, and Help menus with streamlined action dropdowns.
